build_LoLAResolver: build a LoRA resolver subclass that implements resolve_lora to fetch adapters from cloud storage
register_LoLAResolver: register a LoRA resolver instance in the global LoRAResolverRegistry by name
get_LoLAResolver: get a registered LoRA resolver instance from LoRAResolverRegistry by its name
list_LoLAResolver: list all supported LoRA resolver names registered in LoRAResolverRegistry
test_LoLAResolver: test a LoRA resolver implementation by calling resolve_lora with a base model and lora name
